summary: The document defines an AssessmentValidationResult class with fields indicating various assessment validation states.
purpose: To encapsulate the validation results for assessments, indicating specific conditions that must be checked.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: Indicates whether an interim assessment was conducted without a final one.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Indicates whether both instructors and supervisors have provided input.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: Indicates if the maximum number of assessments has been exceeded.
